schema.container: plain JSON array in each split file
schema.prev: English string of at most 180 characters, or null; previous user context only

split_policy.seed_role: recorded experiment identifier; assignments are authored and fixed, not a random sample

limitations: Authored balanced screening corpus, not representative traffic or blind certification.
Rows within a family are correlated; 360 rows are not 360 independent instruction constructions.
Competencies intentionally recur across splits; family separation does not prove semantic independence.
Held-out construction novelty is an authored claim requiring independent pre-fit adjudication, not a measured property.
Paired instructions can create lexical shortcuts; paired public topics and varied transformations mitigate but do not eliminate them.
Identifiers, family, expected labels and reasons are metadata and must not enter encoder features.
Character limits are not a tokenizer-specific guarantee of the 256-token reference budget.
Relative dates are deliberately unresolved lookup targets; no live facts or answers are stored.
Classification cannot establish retrieval usefulness, supported-answer latency, provider behavior or physical performance.
No training, feature extraction, inference, predictions or network lookup was performed during corpus preparation.
